Based on the information provided, Sara and her husband both have a family history of asthma, and their baby is exhibiting symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath, particularly at night. These factors suggest that the baby is at an increased risk for developing asthma or other reactive airway diseases. The combination of genetic predisposition (family history) and early respiratory symptoms warrants medical evaluation to confirm the diagnosis and establish an appropriate management plan.
